parts.title: January 2026
parts.html:
Gulf ties: UAE President in New Delhi

  • UAE President Sheikh Mohamed bin Zayed Al Nahyan came on 19 January 2026, his third official India visit as President (fifth visit in ten years).
  • Target set to double bilateral trade to US$200 billion by 2032.
  • HPCL signed a 10-year deal to buy 0.5 MTPA of LNG from ADNOC Gas, starting 2028.
  • Gujarat and the UAE Ministry of Investment signed an MoU on the Dholera Special Investment Region.
  • IN-SPACe and the UAE Space Agency agreed to build space-industry links; a letter of intent on a Strategic Defence Partnership was also signed.
  • India's C-DAC and UAE's G42 will set up a supercomputing cluster in India; First Abu Dhabi Bank and DP World will open in GIFT City; a House of India will come up in Abu Dhabi.

Europe: the big trade pact

  • The India–EU Free Trade Agreement was declared concluded at the 16th India–EU Summit, New Delhi, on 27 January 2026.
  • The EU becomes India's 22nd FTA partner; the pact is being called the "Mother of All Deals".
  • Indian exports get preferential entry on 97% of EU tariff lines (99.5% of trade value); India opens 92.1% of its lines to the EU.
  • Services: India gets access in 144 sub-sectors, the EU in 102.
  • India and the EU together make up about 25% of world GDP and one-third of world trade.
16th India–EU Summit: co-chaired on the EU side by European Council President António Costa and Commission President Ursula von der Leyen, who were also chief guests at India's 77th Republic Day.

Germany's Chancellor in Gujarat

  • Friedrich Merz made his first official visit to India; talks with PM Modi in Ahmedabad, then the International Kite Festival at the Sabarmati Riverfront.
  • 2026 marks 75 years of India–Germany diplomatic ties and 25 years of strategic partnership.
  • Germany announced visa-free transit for Indian passport holders and opened an honorary consulate in Ahmedabad.
  • The National Maritime Heritage Complex, Lothal tied up with the German Maritime Museum, Bremerhaven.

Country round-up

  • Bulgaria adopted the euro and became the 21st Eurozone member; the euro is sole legal tender from 1 February.
  • Denmark became the first country to stop its 400-year-old letter delivery service.
  • France passed a bill to bar social media for children under 15, from the September 2026 school year.
  • Two Peruvian municipalities, Satipo and Nauta, gave legal rights to Amazonian stingless bees – the first insects anywhere to get such rights.
  • Australia's Finke River (Northern Territory) was recognised as the world's oldest continuously flowing river.
  • Ecuador's President Daniel Noboa declared a 60-day emergency over criminal violence.
  • The US announced withdrawal from 66 international bodies, including the International Solar Alliance.
  • The US labelled the Egyptian, Lebanese and Jordanian branches of the Muslim Brotherhood as terrorist organisations.
  • The EU's Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (CBAM) took effect on 1 January 2026 on steel, aluminium, cement and fertiliser imports.
  • Spain joined the Indo-Pacific Oceans Initiative (IPOI).
  • New UNSC non-permanent members from 1 Jan 2026: Bahrain, Colombia, DR Congo, Latvia, Liberia. Members serving till end-2026: Denmark, Greece, Pakistan, Panama, Somalia.
  • The UN named 2026 the International Year of Rangelands and Pastoralists; 2026 is also the ASEAN–India Year of Maritime Cooperation.
  • The Smithsonian's National Museum of Asian Art will return three stolen bronzes to India from Tamil Nadu temples, including a Chola Shiva Nataraja (c. 990 AD).
  • Akasa Air became the 5th Indian airline to join IATA.
  • Storms: Hayley (cyclone, Western Australia), Goretti (northern France, southern England), Fern (North America).
  • Astronaut Sunita Williams retired from NASA after 27 years; joined in 1998, first person to run a marathon in space; Padma Bhushan 2008; father from Jhulasan (Mehsana, Gujarat).
International Solar Alliance: launched by India and France at COP21, Paris (2015); headquarters at Gurugram, Haryana.
IPOI: India's Indo-Pacific Oceans Initiative, announced by PM Modi at the East Asia Summit in Bangkok, 2019.
